'''University of Rudrig Press''' was the publisher of ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy: A True Story of the Scoundrel and a Scholar]]'', a publication that was written by the [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] historian [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]]. The publisher was presumably affiliated with the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]].
